purpose: Test whether one mechanically focal user-assistant turn pair can preserve an explored alternative and its specifically attached condition or limit without a full-conversation exploration reader or global semantic synthesizer.

failure_basis.repeated_failure: The Case-02 full-conversation reader recovered the named-role alternative only after a chronological repair and still repeatedly omitted its immediately following not-all-ownership qualification.
failure_basis.ablation_result: Omitting the auxiliary ledger recovered neither part, so ledger anchoring was not supported as the root cause.

architecture.focal_unit: all user and assistant messages sharing one chronological turn index
architecture.read_only_context: the immediately preceding turn pair when one exists

duplicate_policy.later_merge_allowed: only through a separately authorized probabilistic consumer with complete lineage

stop_rules: Stop if any protected alternative and its attached limit cannot be cited from one focal turn pair.
Stop if focal evidence does not partition authoritative sentence aliases exactly once.
Stop if prior context can be cited as focal evidence.
Stop if the design requires semantic deduplication or global synthesis to create a readable append-only artifact.
Do not make a provider call under this contract.
non_goals: changing the four full-conversation readers that passed development review
quality, trust, effort, or proof-of-work scoring
